services.name: Cold Plunge
services.desc: Dive into a refreshing and invigorating wellness journey with our cold plunge therapy at Balance House, your premier cold plunge destination in St. Pete. Whether you’re looking to recover post-workout, reduce inflammation, or boost mental clarity, our state-of-the-art facilities provide the perfect environment. Cold plunge therapy involves immersing your body in chilled water, typically between 50°F and 59°F, to promote recovery and rejuvenation. This therapy is known to enhance circulation, reduce muscle soreness, and stimulate the release of mood-boosting hormones. Clean, Circulated Water: Our tubs use advanced filtration systems to ensure a hygienic experience every time. Supportive

services.name: Traditional Sauna
services.desc: At Balance House Studio, we offer an authentic traditional sauna experience designed to promote relaxation, detoxification, and overall well-being. Our facility provides a serene environment where you can unwind and reap the numerous health benefits associated with regular sauna use. Detoxification: Sweating in a sauna helps flush toxins from the body, promoting overall detoxification. Improved Circulation: The heat from a sauna causes blood vessels to dilate, improving circulation and enhancing cardiovascular health.
